Flexible partitioning of heritability

Source: R/partition_h2.R
partition_h2.Rd

An R implementation of the LD score regression method to estimate SNP heritability, focusing on partioning heritability across multiple annotations.

Usage

partition_h2(
  sumstat,
  ldscore_dirs,
  subset_annots = NULL,
  overlapping_annotations = FALSE,
  weights = NULL,
  n_blocks = 200
)

Arguments

sumstat

A dplyr::tibble() with columns SNP, Z and N

ldscore_dirs

a list of directories containing ldscore files

subset_annots

a character vector of annotations to subset the ldscore files. Use get_annot_names()

overlapping_annotations

are the annotations overlapping? In such a case, the estimate of the enrichment estimate needs to be adjusted.

weights

Optional, a data.frame or tbl with columns SNP, L2

n_blocks

Number of blocks to use for the jackknife estimator

Value

a tibble with results

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
partition_h2(sumstat, ldscore_dirs, subset_annots = c("L2", "L3"))
} # }
